item.title: She became Uganda's first wildlife veterinarian: Meet Dr. Gladys Kalema-Zikusoka
item.description: Dr. Gladys Kalema-Zikusoka dedicates her efforts to conserving mountain gorillas in Uganda by engaging local communities and addressing health concerns. Through her organization, Conservation Through Public Health, she enhances the well-being of both gorillas and humans. Additionally, she founded Gorilla Conservation Coffee, which financially empowers farmers by promoting sustainable coffee farming while ensuring the protection of gorilla habitats, highlighting the necessity of teamwork in wildlife conservation and community development. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

Uruguay es el país culturalmente más secularizado de la región y el primero que aprobó el divorcio, allá por 1907. item.title: Rise in NHS birth centre closures ‘shocking’ denial of women’s rights, experts say
item.description: Twelve midwife-led maternity units have closed in England since 2019 with six closing since Labour came to power in 2024 NHS officials are shutting growing numbers of birth centres in a “shocking” denial of a woman’s right to have a midwife rather than a doctor oversee their baby’s birth, say campaigners. Twelve birth centres – midwife-led maternity units – have closed in England since 2019. Birth centres play a key role in ensuring that women can choose whether to have their baby at a unit in a hospital run by doctors, at one where midwives are in charge, or at home. Continue reading...
